meta.name: The Manipulated
meta.description: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Taejoong, a deliveryman dreaming of opening a flower café, is arrested for murder. His loved ones race to prove his innocence but will it be enough?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Taejoong endures brutal life in prison with things going worse but begins to find inspiration again until a new inmate reveals a shocking truth.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Yohan, the CEO of a powerful company, receives a troubling call. Meanwhile, Taejoong embarks on a dangerous mission, meticulously plotting every step.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Taejoong meticulously plots his escape despite relentless harassment. Overcoming obstacles, his plan begins to form but unexpected challenges arise.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Yohan's business is exposed, revealing a shocking truth. Unaware, Taejoong is trapped in a game: a race with 12 criminals in a mysterious location.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: No rules, just racers ready to risk it all. Taejoong enters a deadly competition with a secret plan, but will he survive?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Taejoong uncovers clues about the mastermind behind his case, uncovering the next victim while guard Yang Cheolhwan and Detective Hwang join forces.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Taejoong teams up with others to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, the culprit discovers Taejoong is still alive and Yohan proceeds with his plan.
